 Media Report: SNY cancels pair of shows, shutters site
 11.06.2026 Share current article via %{socialType} Share current article via %{socialType} Share current article via %{socialType} Share current article via %{socialType} Share current article via %{socialType} Share current article via %{socialType} Share current article via %{socialType} Share current article via %{socialType} SNY, the regional broadcast home of the Mets, has reportedly “canceled the programs Baseball Night in New York and Sportsnite.” (Photo by Rich Schultz/Getty Images) SNY, the regional broadcast home of the Mets, has “canceled the programs Baseball Night in New York and Sportsnite,” per sources cited by THE ATHLETIC. The network also “shuttered its website and laid off much of its editorial staff.” The moves “take effect immediately.” The network will “continue to produce pre- and postgame shows for the Mets and New York Jets” and continue to “air the Mets Hot Stove Show” ( THE ATHLETIC, 11/6 ).
